name: 95A3BCF8-O-city-v1
gpu: none: CPU-only RGB authoring of native texels (no ComfyUI, no generated imagery, no fonts)
why:
the user's distant green/pink "signs" are this region (claude-backlog/sign-census/WORLD-SIGN-CENSUS.md section 4). It is
drawn ONLY with palettes 60245B3A (green, 714 draws, max quad 13,932 native px^2 ~ 118 px) and 07A9568D (pink/orange/white,
510 draws), both fully opaque (stp 0, no raw 0x0000 colour => class 127 at every texel). At a 4K output the largest draw is
~1,000 px for 64 texels, so a 16x page is shown ~1:1; the live 2048 page (w2-v2) renders every window texel as a flat
rectangle with a faint vertical stripe.
integration: drop-in: replace pack files 95A3BCF8-60245B3A.png and 95A3BCF8-07A9568D.png with page2048/ (same size as live; only region O RGB differs) or page4096/ (4K option: 4x the upload bytes; the rest of the page is re-rendered from the w2-v2 float master, see validation outside_O_box2_vs_live2048_*)
known_limits: faithful re-rendering of the native window texels: no window is invented; each lit window reads as one framed pane, not a detailed room
the w3-emissive set 95A3BCF8-O-emissive-v1 derives its masks from the w2-v2 PNGs; it does NOT match this rebuild. Regenerate masks from these pages before using emissive with them
no runtime mipmaps by default: crisp frames can shimmer when the region is minified; the private v5/v6 RGB-only class-mip sidecars address that
page4096 raises upload size (stutter risk on first use); page2048 is the size-neutral option
SIMULATION only: not integrated, not seen live
